description: The domain closes on calendar days read on the document clock, not on instants - in a UTC+14 zone the first day's instants begin before 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z, and the timed occurrence at 0001-01-01 00:30 local is generated and answered
spec: Evaluation model - the date domain; an occurrence's instant may exceed the domain by the zone offset, the bound is on the day
